# ADR-3077: A07: Plaintext password recovery channel for user 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Emailing passwords defeats hashing controls.

## Decision

Recovery flows MUST NOT send a plaintext password recovery channel for user 5 (A07-5).

## Consequences

Use single-use reset tokens only.
